# Totem de Atendimento

> Internal queue management system for student/service ticket kiosks (Unilab and CRE), covering public ticket generation, an attendant console, an admin panel, and a TV display.

This is an internal operational tool, not a public content site. It requires authentication for staff-facing screens and is not intended to be indexed, summarized, or crawled by search engines or AI agents.

## Notes

- No public documentation or content is exposed at this domain.
- API access requires an API key and, for staff routes, a bearer token.
